title: Beyond the 956: Roberto Ruy, Mexican actor of Rubí and Clase 406, dies at 78
excerpt: Roberto Ruíz Meléndez, the Mexican actor known as Roberto Ruy and remembered for his roles in the Televisa telenovelas Rubí and Clase 406, has died at 78.
content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Roberto Ruíz Meléndez, the Mexican film and television actor known as Roberto Ruy, has died at 78.

Ruy's death was announced Thursday, November 19, 2026, by the National Actors Association (ANDA), Mexico's actors union. No official cause of death has been disclosed.

Over a long career in Mexican television, Ruy appeared in some of Televisa's most popular productions, including the telenovelas Rubí, Clase 406, ¡Vivan los niños!, Muchachitas como tú, Un gancho al corazón and Hasta que el dinero nos separe. He also appeared in the long-running series Mujer, casos de la vida real, La rosa de Guadalupe and Como dice el dicho.

On the big screen, his credits included the Mexican films Pueblo de violencia, El soplón asesino, El salario de la muerte, La cantina, Taquito de ojo, El embustero and La fiera.

Though he did not always play leading roles, Ruy was a familiar face to generations of Mexican television viewers, appearing in popular productions across several decades.

Rest in Peace, Roberto Ruy.

Sources: ANDA; Te Decimos Cómo.
